description: Official LaTeX template for full paper submissions to the LISBON International Symposium on Applications of Laser and Imaging Techniques to Fluid Mechanics. Provides a single-column A4-landscape-derived (4:3 aspect ratio) layout with custom running headers/footers and first-page banner, custom title/author/address/abstract commands, palatino-styled equation numbering, and APA-style citations via apacite/natbib, based on a custom LxSymp_2026_Paper_Format document class built on extarticle.
